story.so_that: I can track my financial activity and maintain an accurate account balance
story.i_want: view my transactions, add new transactions, and see my current balance in a secure banking application

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Display existing transactions for logged-in account
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a user is logged in When they view the transaction list Then they see all transactions impacting their account sorted by date descending

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Add new transactions to existing accounts
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a user is logged in When they submit a new transaction with valid date, payee, and amount Then the transaction is recorded and balance is updated immediately

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Show only transactions that impact the current user's account
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given multiple accounts exist in the system When a user logs in Then they see only transactions where their account is involved
Given transactions are displayed When a user views the balance Then it reflects the sum of all transactions for their account

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Cannot create transactions for more money than available
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given an account has a balance of $100 When a user attempts to add a transaction of -$150 Then the transaction is rejected with error 'Insufficient funds'

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Can only set transactions for today or past dates
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a user is adding a transaction When they attempt to set a date in the future Then the transaction is rejected with error 'Future dates not allowed'
Given a transaction exists in the list When a user views the transaction Then no delete button or option is available

acceptance_criteria.criterion: System handles up to 50-100 transactions displayed at once
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given an account has 100 transactions When the user views the transaction list Then all 100 are displayed without pagination and load time is under 2 seconds
Given 5 accounts exist (A-E) When a user logs in with Account B credentials Then they access Account B and see only Account B transactions

acceptance_criteria.criterion: User session persists across page refreshes
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a user is logged in When they refresh the page Then they remain logged in and see their transactions
Given a user is logged in When they click logout Then their session ends and they return to login screen

edge_cases.gherkin: Given a user is adding a transaction When they leave payee field empty Then the transaction is rejected with error 'Payee is required'
Given a user is adding a transaction When they enter amount as 0 Then the transaction is rejected with error 'Amount must be non-zero'
Given a user is adding a transaction When they enter amount exceeding $1,000,000 Then the transaction is rejected with error 'Amount exceeds maximum'
Given a new account with zero transactions When a user logs in Then they see empty transaction list with message 'No transactions yet'
Given an account has zero balance When a user attempts to add a negative transaction Then the transaction is rejected with error 'Insufficient funds'

edge_cases.criterion: Multiple users accessing same account simultaneously
edge_cases.gherkin: Given two users are logged into the same account When one adds a transaction Then the other sees the updated balance after refresh
Given a user is adding a transaction When they enter an invalid date format Then the transaction is rejected with error 'Invalid date format'
Given a user session has expired When they attempt to add a transaction Then they are redirected to login with message 'Session expired'
Given a user enters incorrect password When they attempt to login Then error message 'Invalid credentials' is displayed

steps.description: Create database tables for Accounts, AccountSecurity, and Transactions with proper constraints, indexes, and relationships
Implement JWT token generation, validation, and bearer token middleware
Implement POST /api/auth/login endpoint with credential validation and token generation
Implement repository pattern for transaction data access
Implement business logic validation for transaction creation
Implement GET and POST endpoints for transaction retrieval and creation
Implement AuthContext for state management and login form component
Implement TransactionContext for transaction list and balance state
Implement transaction list view with TanStack Table for sortable columns
Implement form for creating new transactions with date picker, amount input, and target account selector
Implement main dashboard layout with routing between login and transaction views
Create seed data with 3-5 test accounts and sample transactions
Implement comprehensive unit tests for authentication and transaction logic
Implement integration tests for endpoint behavior and database interactions
Implement unit tests for components and state management
Implement integration tests for component interactions and API calls
Implement end-to-end tests for complete user workflows

unit_tests.description: Transaction validation business rules (sufficient funds, valid date, non-zero amount)

integration_tests.description: Transaction endpoints with repository and validation service

e2e_tests.description: Complete login flow with valid/invalid credentials
Add new transaction and see balance update
Logout and return to login screen
Account isolation (user sees only their transactions)

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Balance calculation errors could cause data integrity issues
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Implement comprehensive unit tests for balance calculation logic, use database-level aggregation queries, add integration tests with multiple transactions

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Concurrent transaction creation could lead to race conditions
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Use database transaction isolation levels (SERIALIZABLE or REPEATABLE READ), implement optimistic locking if needed, test concurrent scenarios

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Performance degradation with large transaction volumes (5,000-10,000)
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Ensure proper database indexing on account_id and transaction_date, implement query optimization, monitor query performance, consider pagination as future enhancement

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Session management complexity and security vulnerabilities
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Use established JWT libraries, implement token expiration (30 minutes), validate token on every protected endpoint, store token securely in localStorage

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Frontend state synchronization issues between AuthContext and TransactionContext
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Implement clear state management patterns, use React hooks properly, add integration tests for context interactions

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Database connection failures during transaction creation
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Implement proper error handling and user-friendly error messages, add retry logic for transient failures, log errors for monitoring

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Cross-account data access if authorization checks are missed
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Implement authorization checks on every endpoint, validate accountId from token matches request parameter, add security-focused integration tests
